content: {"like": ["The 2015 production with Paul Dano is far superior to the 1972 BBC series.", "The 2015 version condenses the novel effectively while still capturing more of Tolstoy's spirit and essence.", "The characters in the 2015 version are more completely and complexly realized."], "dislike": ["The 1972 BBC series features excruciatingly amateurish and stiff acting from the entire cast.", "The acting in the 1972 series is overacted and full of excesses, especially the portrayal of Natasha.", "The 1972 production weakly and unconvincingly realizes the novel, turning it into a dull and embarrassing mimicry of the real thing."]}
